query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.cluster.name') FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_users' AND JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.cluster.name')!='' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Users

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp,  JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_users' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_users' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Everyone who ever completed the OAuth flow.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp,  JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_active_users' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_active_users' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sessions

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp,  JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_sessions' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_sessions' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: One per browser, so higher than the user count.

panels.title: Distinct accounts fetched

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp,  JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_accounts_distinct' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_accounts_distinct' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Deduplicated across users — this is the real scraping load, not the sum of what people follow.

panels.title: Unreadable PDS

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp,  JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_users_unreadable' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_users_unreadable' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Revoked app or expired token. Their followed accounts are missing from the counts.

panels.title: Accounts followed by source

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'source') AS series, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_accounts_followed' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_accounts_followed' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster, series) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Counts each follow, so two people following one account count twice.

panels.title: Scrape queue depth

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'source') AS series, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_scrape_queue_waiting' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_scrape_queue_waiting' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster, series) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Requests waiting for a slot. Sustained depth means the concurrency cap is too low for the number of readers.

panels.title: Requests joined in flight

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'source') AS series, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_scrape_joined' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_scrape_joined' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster, series) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Requests served by one already running instead of hitting the instance again. This is what protects the volunteer hosts.

panels.title: Outbound call latency

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'quantile') AS series, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_call_latency_ms' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_call_latency_ms' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster, series) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Over the in-memory log window, which resets on redeploy.

panels.title: Pod CPU

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp,  JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='k8s.pod.cpu.usage' AND JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.namespace.name')='blueweave' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='k8s.pod.cpu.usage' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Cores used by the blueweave pod. Compare with the 500m limit in the Deployment.

panels.title: Pod memory (working set)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp,  JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='k8s.pod.memory.working_set' AND JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.namespace.name')='blueweave' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='k8s.pod.memory.working_set' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Against a 256Mi limit — this is what gets the pod OOMKilled if it climbs.

panels.title: Pod memory vs limit

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp,  JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='k8s.pod.memory_limit_utilization' AND JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.namespace.name')='blueweave' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='k8s.pod.memory_limit_utilization' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Ratio of the limit. Sustained above ~0.9 means the limit needs raising before the kernel decides for you.

panels.title: Accounts scraped by source

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'source') AS series, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_accounts_scraped' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_accounts_scraped' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster, series) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Distinct accounts the scraper has actually touched, X and Mastodon apart.

panels.title: Scrape attempts by outcome

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'outcome') AS series, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_scrape_total' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_scrape_total' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster, series) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Cumulative since start, so it resets on redeploy. 'cached' means served without a request at all.

panels.title: Failing accounts

targets.rawSql: SELECT JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'source') AS source, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'account') AS account, anyLast(s.value) AS up FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_scrape_up' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_scrape_up' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) AND JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY source, account HAVING up = 0 ORDER BY source, account

panels.description: Accounts whose last real attempt failed. Empty is the healthy state.

panels.title: Minutes since last successful scrape

targets.rawSql: SELECT JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'source') AS source, JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'account') AS account, round((toUnixTimestamp(now()) - anyLast(s.value))/60) AS minutes_ago FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS lbl FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_scrape_last_success_seconds' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_scrape_last_success_seconds' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) AND JSONExtractString(t.lbl,'k8s.cluster.name') IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY source, account ORDER BY minutes_ago DESC

panels.description: Catches an account that reports up but quietly stopped returning posts. The cache TTL is 15 min, so anything far past that is suspect.
